app.title: Arif Visual Answers

notice.demo: Demo only — do not upload confidential documents.

footer.residency: Demo uses Google Gemini API — production can run on a self-hosted model.

error.generic: Something went wrong while generating the answer.
error.timeout: The model took too long. Here is what arrived.
verify.partial: Some values were removed because they could not be verified.
verify.downgraded: Shown as a table: too few verified points for a chart.
source.title: Page {n}

cards.hint: Press Enter or Space to flip.

compare.diff: Visual answer vs text: {cost} cost · {time} time
